missing: A tested, price-ranked comparison of the cheapest enclosure + NVMe drive combos (and ready-made portable SSDs) for the M4. It would give current total cost per TB and sustained real speeds over the M4's USB4/Thunderbolt 4 ports. It would also cover whether running apps and a Photos library from the external drive works reliably (APFS format, ownership settings, sleep and disconnects).
why: Major reviewers have this partly covered. TechRadar's hands-on guide to an enclosure plus NVMe drive for the M4 answers the question most directly. Macworld adds a tested Ugreen dock review, a deal on its Editors' Choice Satechi USB4 enclosure, and a general upgrade guide. None of them compares the cheapest options side by side with current prices. The niche sites (Hard Bargains, EveryMac, RatioDB) give costs or lists of options without testing. A focused page could get in, but it would compete with the TechRadar guide and Macworld's group of pages.
